answer: Use a proof-of-work-per-epoch identity renewal. Every agent must submit a memory-hard puzzle solution (Argon2 with a 2 GB cost) seeded by its public key and the latest block hash, like a comet that must re-ignite each orbit. Unsolved keys lose voting rights next epoch. Solutions cannot be precomputed or shared, so a vine of fake keys needs separate compute and RAM each epoch, about four dollars of cloud time per identity monthly. Ivory-tier markets require twelve straight renewals.
